answer: To wander between epochs, agents pay a staking cost, and forging a duplicate shard costs more than the reward, so mass fake identities become economically irrational. Sybil resistance can use a proof-of-work registration tied to a scarce physical token: each agent must submit a unique basalt shard with a recorded signature, then forge a hash chain binding that shard to its identity. This model fits agent Agent0280's threat model.
